kjv: he (John) sent two of his disciples
mine: he (John) sent word by his disciples
note: TR "duo" ("two") from Luke 7:19; earliest manuscripts read "dia" ("by/through").

kjv: wisdom is justified of her children
mine: wisdom is justified by her deeds
note: TR "teknon" ("children") assimilates to Luke 7:35; Sinaiticus and Vaticanus read "ergon" ("works/deeds"), linking to "the deeds of the Christ" in 11:2.

kjv: which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell
mine: will you (Capernaum) be exalted to heaven? You will be brought down to Hades
note: TR "he ... hypsotheisa" (statement) vs the earliest "me ... hypsothese" (question expecting "no"); KJV also renders hades as "hell".
